description: This file defines an interface Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage for storage mechanisms used in the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent component. It declares methods for checking if storage is empty, reading, writing, and clearing stored data, along with associated exception handling.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage
classes.description: Interface specifying the contract for storage classes used by the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent component, including methods for checking emptiness, reading, writing, and clearing storage.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if and only if storage is empty, throws exception if determination is impossible.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the contents of storage associated with a key, behavior undefined if storage is empty, throws exception if reading is impossible.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes contents to storage, associated with a key, throws exception if writing fails.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears contents from storage, throws exception if clearing fails.
